bias.en: Bullish · overbought, just below the record
bias.zh: 偏多 · 超买，紧贴纪录高点

read.en: Microsoft rose 0.4% on Oct 13 to $543.45 after touching $551.15, close to its October 2025 record. It is above all its rising averages: the 5-day ($534.4), 10-day ($527.0), 30-day ($508.9), 100-day ($451.9) and 200-day ($434.6). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 1, Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Aug 28 ($520.7), and RSI is 71, overbought.
read.zh: 微软 10月13日盘中触及 $551.15，接近 2025年10月的纪录高点，收涨 0.4% 至 $543.45。股价位于所有上行均线上方：5 日（$534.4）、10 日（$527.0）、30 日（$508.9）、100 日（$451.9）和 200 日均线（$434.6）。MACD 自 10月1日起位于信号线上方，抛物线 SAR 自 8月28日起看多（$520.7），RSI 为 71，处于超买。

read.en: The record zone at $553–555 is still the test after the day's high stopped short of it. A close above $555 would put Microsoft at a new record with no chart resistance overhead. Support is $537 (prior resistance, Oct 9 high), then $527–534 (5 and 10-day averages) and $521 (Parabolic SAR); the 30-day average ($509) is deeper support.
read.zh: 当日高点未能触及 $553–555 纪录区，该区域仍是关键考验。若收盘站上 $555，微软将创新高，上方再无图形阻力。支撑为 $537（原阻力，10月9日高点），其次 $527–534（5 日和 10 日均线）和 $521（抛物线 SAR）；30 日均线（$509）为更深一层支撑。

s.zh: 抛物线 SAR；其下为30日均线 $509
